parameters.name: AccessType
parameters.description:
The access type of the WAF instance. Valid values:

- **share** (default): CNAME access.
- **hybrid\_cloud_cname**: hybrid cloud reverse proxy access.

parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description:
The domain name that has been connected to WAF.

> You must specify at least one of **Domain** and **DomainId**.

parameters.name: DomainId
parameters.description:
The domain name ID.

> You must specify at least one of **Domain** and **DomainId**.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.
> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
